Package domain

Class Question

java.lang.Object
domain.Question
Direct Known Subclasses:
FreeQuestion, MultipleChoiceQuestion, NumericalQuestion, OrderedSingleQuestion
public abstract class Question extends Object
Abstract class representing a question in a survey or form Serves as the base class for all specific question types
